greeting: Harbor-Hank! I paint what you need to KNOW!
You look lost! Good thing I'm HERE!
Back again? New signs went up! Notice them?
Welcome to the harbor! Follow the SIGNS!
New face! Need directions? I make directions!
I paint warnings! Instructions! Advertisements! ALL OF IT!
The harbor speaks through my brushes! Listen!
dialog.sign_examples: 'NO SWIMMING.' 'WATCH FOR FALLING CRATES.' 'FRESH FISH THIS WAY.' 'DON'T FEED THE SEAGULLS.' They keep adding rules!
dialog.paint_preferences: Blue for water! Red for danger! Yellow for... caution? Optimism? Both!
dialog.weather_problems: Salt air RUINS paint. I repaint monthly. Job security!
dialog.nautical_symbols: Anchor means dock! Wavy lines mean water! Skull means... bad business. Rare. But happens.
rumor: Tide's harbor is BUSY. Signs everywhere. I'm EXHAUSTED.
Mire's signs SINK. They need BOUY signs. Floating warnings.
Aetherreach signs are in the CLOUDS. Impossible to read.
Frost's signs are ICE-carved. Beautiful. Melty.
dialog.favorite_sign: My masterpiece? 'NO RUNNING ON DECKS.' Painted it forty times. Perfected the waves in the background.
farewell: Follow the arrows! They point to TRUTH!
Safe harbor! Watch for new signage!
Come back! I'll have new paint!
dialog.time_noon: Peak painting! Everyone sees my work!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening lettering! Best light for detail!
dialog.time_night: Closed! Signs sleep! So do I!

party_reactions.kade: Clear signage saves lives. Good work.
party_reactions.twist: Can I paint one?! PLEASE?! I'll be CAREFUL!
party_reactions.korr: A well-marked harbor is a safe harbor.
party_reactions.renna: Do you ever use magical paints? Glowing letters?
party_reactions.suresh: Guidance helps the lost find their way. Noble work.
party_reactions.sova: I appreciate clear directions. Especially for exits.
party_reactions.grit: Clear signs won battles. 'Hold here.' 'Retreat there.' Vital.
party_reactions.ashka: Signs are good. But fire teaches faster.
party_reactions.senna: I read all signs. Then decide which to ignore.
party_reactions.callum: The fish sign is my favorite! So realistic!

relationship_dialog.stranger: New here? Follow the blue signs!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're back! Notice my new work?
relationship_dialog.friend: My friend! I'll paint you a PERSONAL sign!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! I named a sign after you! 'HERO PARKING!' Exclusive!
